This 2006 GS 300 Sedan carries 183,052 miles, which in the context of Lexus reliability is less alarming than it would be for most other brands. These cars are genuinely engineered to go the distance, and a well-maintained GS 300 at this mileage can still deliver a premium driving experience that rivals much newer vehicles. Buyers who prioritize value over low odometer numbers will find this an honest, real-world car with years of life left when properly maintained.2006 Lexus GS 300 Performance and EngineV6 Power with Real-World Refinement Under the hood sits Lexus's 3.0-liter V6 with Variable Valve Timing (VVT-i), producing approximately 245 horsepower and delivering the kind of smooth, linear power delivery that made this generation GS a benchmark for the segment. Paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission with overdrive, the GS 300 moves through gears with near-imperceptible transitions  a hallmark of Lexus engineering at its best.The rear-wheel-drive layout gives this sedan a properly sporty character. Around town in Hayward or out on Interstate 880, the GS 300 feels composed, confident, and eager  never stressed. The RWD platform also means a more balanced weight distribution (approximately 52/48 front-to-rear), contributing to the car's well-regarded handling dynamics. For drivers who actually care about how a car feels behind the wheel, this layout is a meaningful advantage over front-wheel-drive luxury competitors of the same era.Lexus GS 300 Features and InteriorA Luxury Cabin That Still Impresses The 2006 GS 300 cabin was designed to compete directly with the BMW 5 Series and Mercedes E-Class, and it holds up remarkably well nearly two decades later. Expect premium leather seating surfaces, genuine wood trim accents, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a driver-focused cockpit layout that puts controls exactly where you want them.The GS 300 also came equipped with Lexus's Multi-Information Display, a power tilt-and-telescoping steering column, and standard power-adjustable front seats with memory settings. The Mark Levinson premium audio system (available on this platform) and navigation system were ahead of their time, and the overall fit and finish remains a testament to Lexus's obsession with quality control. Rear passengers enjoy generous legroom for a sport sedan, making this a genuinely usable family car despite its performance-oriented character.Lexus GS 300 Reliability and OwnershipWhat Owners and Experts Say The 2006 Lexus GS 300 has earned a strong reputation in the used car market for one straightforward reason: these cars simply don't fall apart. J.D. Power and Consumer Reports have historically ranked this generation of GS among the top performers in long-term reliability, and owner forums are filled with stories of GS 300s surpassing 200,000 and even 250,000 miles with nothing more than routine maintenance.The 3GR-FSE engine in this vehicle is a proven, robust unit. Common ownership considerations at higher mileages include ensuring the timing chain service is up to date, checking the condition of the power steering system, and monitoring the suspension bushings  all standard maintenance items for a car of this age and mileage. With proper upkeep, repair costs on the GS 300 tend to be significantly lower than comparable European luxury sedans, making it a smarter long-term ownership proposition for budget-conscious luxury buyers throughout Alameda County.Why Buy From Import Auto World in Hayward, CA Import Auto World, located in Hayward in Alameda County, California, specializes in exactly the kind of vehicle this is  quality import and luxury vehicles for discerning buyers who know what they're looking for. Call Import Auto World at 510-939-7225 to discuss pre-qualification, trade-in values, or to ask any questions about financing this specific vehicle before you make the drive in.Frequently Asked QuestionsIs the 2006 Lexus GS 300 a good buy? Yes  the 2006 GS 300 is widely regarded as one of the best value luxury sport sedans available in the used market. It offers near-BMW driving dynamics, Mercedes-level build quality, and long-term reliability that consistently outperforms its European competitors. For buyers in the Hayward area seeking a refined daily driver at a realistic price, it's a compelling choice. Is 183,000 miles too many for a Lexus GS 300? Not necessarily. Lexus vehicles  especially those equipped with the VVT-i V6 engine  are known to reach 200,000-250,000 miles with regular oil changes and maintenance. A 183,000-mile GS 300 that has been properly cared for can still have significant life ahead of it. A pre-purchase inspection by a qualified Lexus technician is always recommended at this mileage. What does the GS 300 trim include? The GS 300 is the base trim of the fourth-generation GS lineup, but "base" for a Lexus means something different than it does for other brands. Standard equipment includes premium leather seating, wood interior trim, power memory front seats, dual-zone climate control, a multi-information display, and Lexus's signature attention to NVH (noise, vibration, and harshness) reduction  making the cabin notably quieter than most competitors. How does the 2006 Lexus GS 300 compare to the GS 430? The GS 300 uses a 3.0-liter V6 while the GS 430 uses a 4.3-liter V8. The V8 offers more horsepower and stronger acceleration, but the GS 300's V6 is lighter, slightly more fuel-efficient, and widely considered more than adequate for daily driving. For buyers who prioritize balance and economy, the GS 300 is often the preferred choice. What should I know before buying a high-mileage Lexus GS? Powered by a 5.3-liter V8 engine producing 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque, it delivers confident performance paired with an efficient 10-speed automatic transmission and 4X4 drive system. This vehicle is designed to handle both daily commutes and weekend adventures, featuring a spacious seating capacity of eight and a suite of premium amenities. Inside, you'll enjoy seamless connectivity with Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, and a Wi-Fi hotspot, along with a premium 10.2-inch infotainment touchscreen, navigation with real-time traffic updates, and a robust 9-speaker audio system. Comfort features include heated seats, rear A/C, memory seats, keyless entry, push start, and a hands-free liftgate. The Suburbans towing capabilities are enhanced by a tow package, making it ideal for hauling trailers or boats. Its elegant white exterior and black interior create a timeless look, while the modern tech and convenience features make every drive enjoyable and connected.This used Chevrolet Suburban offers a comprehensive suite of safety and security features to ensure peace of mind. It includes a rear seat reminder to prevent accidental forgetfulness, front airbags centered for added protection, and parking sensors at both front and rear to assist with maneuvering. The vehicle is equipped with ABS on all four wheels, anti-lockout power door locks, auto-locking system, and a programmable safety key, all designed to enhance safety for drivers and passengers alike. These features work together to provide a secure driving environment, whether navigating busy city streets or heading off-road.2022 Chevrolet Suburban Safety and Security FeaturesThe vehicle is equipped with a check rear seat reminder to alert drivers to check the back seats before exiting. It features front airbags positioned centrally for optimal protection, complemented by parking sensors at the front and rear to aid parking and low-speed maneuvering. The four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) ensures stability under heavy braking, while power door locks include anti-lockout and auto-locking functions for added security. A programmable safety key offers customizable access and control, making this Suburban a dependable choice for safety-conscious drivers.2022 Chevrolet Suburban Entertainment and Technology FeaturesThis Suburban is loaded with advanced entertainment and connectivity options, including compatibility with the myChevrolet app featuring Connected Access for smart device integration. The large 10.2-inch infotainment touchscreen provides a user-friendly interface with real-time traffic updates, navigation, and app marketplace integration. Voice-operated hands-free calling and radio enhance convenience, while Pandora internet radio offers a variety of entertainment. The sound system includes nine speakers delivering immersive audio, and the vehicle offers Bluetooth connectivity for seamless device pairing. Additional features include read function for electronic messaging assistance, ensuring staying connected is effortless and safe while on the road.2022 Chevrolet Suburban Performance FeaturesDesigned for versatility and capability, the Suburban features a part-time 4WD system with an on-demand setting that adapts to driving conditions, providing improved traction when needed. A rear limited-slip differential helps distribute power evenly across the rear wheels for better stability.
